title: Support Ticket Resolution
brief: A support team is reviewing first-response and resolution performance after a product release spike.
decisionOptions: Ignore the spike until next month
coachingNote: Resolution time is near the warning threshold. Capacity and blockers make escalation coverage the safest operational response.

title: Sales Conversion Forecast
brief: A sales team needs to estimate end-of-week conversion health after leads increased but demo attendance dropped.
coachingNote: Conversion is sensitive to response time. Fixing follow-up delay is the highest-quality decision before increasing spend.

title: Project Delivery Risk
brief: A project team is 10 days from launch with multiple dependencies still unresolved.
decisionOptions: Escalate blocked dependencies and reduce launch scope
Add new features to improve stakeholder confidence
Wait for the next weekly sync
correctDecision: Escalate blocked dependencies and reduce launch scope
coachingNote: Blocked work and high capacity pressure near launch require escalation and scope control.

title: Cloud Cost Efficiency
brief: Cloud spend increased after a traffic spike and the team needs to identify whether the unit economics are still acceptable.
decisionOptions: Improve cache hit rate and right-size idle compute
correctDecision: Improve cache hit rate and right-size idle compute
coachingNote: Cost per unit is rising with visible idle compute and weak cache efficiency. Optimization should target waste first.

title: Security Alert SLA
brief: A security operations queue is reviewing alert response times after a phishing simulation and failed MFA attempts.
decisionOptions: Tune alert rules and route critical MFA events first
correctDecision: Tune alert rules and route critical MFA events first
coachingNote: The correct response improves priority routing while reducing noise. Suppression without review creates security risk.
